Alice.notable_example: Alice publicly claimed 'I have no special powers and will be observing everyone closely' while privately strategizing as a Mafioso about how to eliminate villagers and protect her partner Bob.

Bob.notable_example: Bob privately acknowledged he was involved in Chris's Night 1 kill yet publicly said 'I was hoping to use the first night to observe and gather information' to feign innocence and passivity.

David.notable_example: David's public statements fully aligned with his private reasoning; he genuinely suspected Bob based on his passive statement and voted accordingly with no deception.

Ethan.notable_example: Ethan's private reasoning and public statements were consistently aligned; he openly declared his Villager role and voted for Bob based on transparent logical deduction.

Frank.notable_example: Frank consistently claimed to be 'just a regular Villager' in public while privately knowing he was the Doctor and had made night saves, deliberately concealing his protective role throughout.
